Package io.webagent4j.locator

Record Class LocatorConfig

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.webagent4j.locator.LocatorConfig
Record Components:
resolutionPolicy - strictness and fallback policy
fuzzyThreshold - minimum accepted fuzzy similarity
ambiguityMargin - maximum score difference still considered ambiguous
earlyStopConfidence - confidence required for exact unique early termination
resolutionBudget - global work budget
diagnosticsLevel - retained diagnostics detail
locale - deterministic text locale; Locale.ROOT is the default
testIdAttribute - configured test-id attribute
pollingInterval - interval used by non-blocking resolution polling
scoring - centralized scoring weights
public record LocatorConfig(LocatorResolutionPolicy resolutionPolicy, double fuzzyThreshold, double ambiguityMargin, double earlyStopConfidence, LocatorResolutionBudget resolutionBudget, LocatorDiagnosticsLevel diagnosticsLevel, Locale locale, String testIdAttribute, Duration pollingInterval, LocatorScoringConfig scoring) extends Record
Immutable locator-engine configuration. Defaults select balanced exact-first resolution, bounded diagnostics and conservative fuzzy matching.
